title: porcelain serving plates 10"
text: porcelain serving plates 10". I have a long rectangle table that I use something like a buffet table during gatherings and I was looking for some rectangle platters/plates for food. These worked perfectly.  They are about 10" long... about 6" wide.  They have a slight, angled lip.  They washed in the dishwasher nicely.  They are a solid white.  I really like them.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: DOWAN Serving Platter, 10 inches Stackable Porcelain Platter with Handle, Good Depth White Dinner Plates Rectangular Set of 4, Serving Dishes for Sandwiches, Appetizers, Salad, Chips, Fruit, Steak
features: Versatile Serving Platter Sets - Size:11.9 * 6 *1.2 in, Maximun Capacity: 21.6 oz, 4-piece. Perfect size for sandwiches and chips, appetizers and fruits, salad and steak. Ideal for the tea time, dinner party, serving outdoors on the patio, wedding and daily use.
Good Depth & Handles Design - The porcelain platter with handles make getting them into and out of the oven easier. And the edge is deep enough to prevent foods spills over the side.

White Rectangular Shape Lends a Modern Touch to the Table - Turning an everyday meal into a fun event, Everything will look elegant when served on these rectangular serving plates (making you look like a chef)

Strong and Safe Enough to Put in the Microwave and Oven - These large dinner plates are crafted with durable, corrosion resistance, acid and alkali resistance porcelain, a type of premium LEAD-FREE and NON-TOXIC ceramic, chip-resistant.
